framework.description: SSG framework for the host's docs site. Use 'none' when the host has no SSG and renders raw markdown via GitHub or another mechanism. Docusaurus support is partial in v0.1; build validation is skipped for 'docusaurus' and 'none'.

citation_example_prefixes.description: Reserved illustrative path namespaces citation_exists never resolves (CCE-131). Replaces the built-in default of ["example"].

citation_exempt_tokens.description: Exact citation tokens whose non-existence is intentional (CCE-131). Unioned with the plugin defaults, never replacing them.

citation_source_roots.description: Extra package roots citation_exists tries when resolving a cited repo path, after the repo root and docs_dir (CCE-139). Additive; empty by default, so a host that declares nothing is unaffected. Single-segment package roots only ("backend", "frontend") — a nested tail like "backend/storage" is suffix-matching in disguise and admits confabulated paths, which is why the pattern rejects any entry containing a slash.

publishing.$comment: CCE-64: base_url and build_workflow accept null to support framework=none hosts (preflight emits null for both). The schema does NOT currently enforce that null is paired with framework=none; a hand-edited {framework: mkdocs, base_url: null} would pass validation but break the publish-verifier. Add a JSON Schema if/then/else guard when a second non-mkdocs framework with publish support ships.

build_command.description: Generic fallback build command for non-MkDocs hosts. Omit for MkDocs (the deploy workflow runs `mkdocs build --strict`).

ci_provider.description: Which CI provider runs the docs publish workflow. Default `github` (no field present). `circleci` is modeled but UNVALIDATED against a live host. Both post-merge seams fork on this field and degrade honestly for a non-github provider rather than acting: scripts/verify_runner.py (verify) returns a non-promoting 'modeled but unvalidated' result instead of polling (CCE-63); _maybe_auto_merge (trigger) records an info_only pages_dispatch_skipped reason instead of a GitHub Actions dispatch (CCE-123). The real CircleCI poll and trigger are stubbed. Only `github` is end-to-end wired. See CCE-63, CCE-123.

time_budget_seconds.description: CCE-109: soft per-run time budget in seconds. 0 = unlimited. Default 2700.

deferral_skip_threshold.description: CCE-140: number of CONSECUTIVE runs a PR may be deferred before the next run abandons it — the advance cursor walks past it, an entry is appended to state.json `skipped_prs`, and a non-informational partial reason names the PR and its pages. Default 3. 0 disables skipping entirely, which restores the pre-CCE-140 indefinite-stall behaviour.

authoring_hard_cap_seconds.description: CCE-152: ceiling in seconds the page-authoring loop may never cross. The soft deadline (time_budget_seconds) only cuts at a PR-group boundary so a run finishes the oldest PR's pages and the baseline can advance; this bounds how far that deferral may push the run. Must be GREATER than time_budget_seconds — a value at or below it collapses the hard deadline onto the soft one and restores the mid-PR-group cut, so it is rejected at config load. Default time_budget_seconds * 1.15, then clamped down against the GitHub App installation token's 1h TTL minus the merge poll and the post-run tail.

merge.$comment: CCE-101: docs-agent PR merge gate. Absent block (or absent policy) = auto.

policy.description: auto (default when absent): squash-merge a fully-green non-partial run's PR. manual: every PR stays open for operator review.

checks_grace_seconds.description: Wait for host CI checks to register before merging without them. Default 120.

checks_timeout_seconds.description: Max wait for registered checks to settle. Default 900.
